args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest issue highlights "Warehouse Automation in 2026" as the week's featured topic, linking to a full article and a companion piece.
- Article: Pick rates rose 18% thanks to autonomous carts, though system integration took twice as long as originally planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest financial/operational saving came from a reduction in mis-picks (picking errors).
